Biography

Sinem Biyikli is a B.Sc. Computer Science student at the Technical University of Applied Sciences Würzburg-Schweinfurt (THWS). As a student assistant in the Faculty of Computer Science and Business Information Systems, she develops StudyPortal, a web platform that guides incoming exchange students through their stay. She is interested in IT security and computer networks, as well as full-stack development and UX/UI design.
